decision: approved for local implementation with stated compatibility constraints
accepted_design: Keep two geometric root hosts, their order, coordinates, 0.26 thickness and opening identities/offsets.
Add one-cell appearance/payment ledger, retaining free dormant ninth west segment with z=8 extension authority.
Allocate paid shares deterministically and use cumulative half-refund differences to preserve exact legacy total refund.
Single-segment replacement consumes only its own refund credit and does not reallocate neighbors.
Use wall_format 2 as forward compatibility guard while outer payload version stays 15.
Validate all segments intersecting each complete aperture interval and keep homogeneous legacy renderer fast-path.
required_constraints: Legacy paid-value migration and validation must use historical accepted values, not mutable future economy prices.
Audit all root height/material consumers, notably corner caps and all opening creation/move/rotation validators, so preserved root snapshots never override current segment state.
Only migrate already validated old inputs; invalid new payloads must leave live model and original file unchanged.
implementation_gates: Real old-client suppression and stale-tab revision-conflict tests, new-client reload and failed durable write tests.
Preserve campaign receipts and original legacy storage.
Pixel-equivalent homogeneous scenes plus mixed-height/material aperture and end-face native QA.
Final integration with door-jamb clipping, stove placement protection, Build selection/price UI and dishwashing service-format migration.
Full combined regression and fresh exact-source CI before any publication.
limits: 27,219 prototype checks reported and test source reviewed; this review did not rerun Godot.
No production migration or browser claim is made by this design approval.
All 0.1.9 remote repository writes remain held.
